fortunes.title: The Golden Opening
fortunes.overall: A small opportunity is about to appear. It may not look important at first, but don’t dismiss it too quickly. Like a Golden Puff, sometimes the best part is hidden inside.
fortunes.health: Your energy is returning. Small improvements to your routine will have a bigger effect than dramatic changes.
fortunes.wealth: A modest opportunity could grow into something worthwhile. Look closely before saying no.
fortunes.love: Someone may show interest subtly rather than dramatically. Pay attention to actions.
fortunes.workStudy: Say yes to the unexpected invitation, assignment, introduction, or collaboration. It may lead somewhere useful.
fortunes.luckyDishNote: Crisp outside, the good part hidden within.

fortunes.title: The Unwrapped Secret
fortunes.overall: Not everything is meant to reveal itself immediately. Like Gai Hor Bai Toey, something worthwhile may still be wrapped. Let curiosity win over impatience.
fortunes.health: Listen to the quieter signals your body is giving you. Rest may be more useful than pushing harder.
fortunes.wealth: Avoid rushing into a financial decision before you have all the information.
fortunes.love: There is more beneath the surface. Give someone time to show you who they are.
fortunes.workStudy: A confusing situation will become clearer soon. Ask questions before making assumptions.
fortunes.luckyDishNote: Wrapped in pandan, worth the unwrapping.

fortunes.title: The Soft Hand
fortunes.overall: You don’t need to force this one. Some things are more like a delicate Thai Crepe Dumpling. They come together through patience and care.
fortunes.health: Give yourself recovery time. Consistency will serve you better than intensity.
fortunes.wealth: Protect what you already have instead of chasing the next big thing.
fortunes.love: Gentleness will get you further than trying to define everything right now.
fortunes.workStudy: Take your time with the details. Craft matters more than speed.
fortunes.luckyDishNote: Delicate work, made with a soft hand.

fortunes.title: The Basil Flame
fortunes.overall: Enough thinking. This fortune carries the energy of Kapraw Gai Sub: hot, direct, and impossible to ignore. Something in your life needs action.
fortunes.health: Move your body and shake off stagnant energy, but don’t run yourself into the ground.
fortunes.wealth: A calculated risk may be worth taking. Calculated is the important word.
fortunes.love: If you want them to know, give them something to work with. Fate cannot flirt entirely on your behalf.
fortunes.workStudy: Send it. Apply. Pitch it. Ask. You’ve probably prepared enough already.

fortunes.title: The Old Path
fortunes.overall: Something from your past deserves another look. Like Pad Thai Bolan, old doesn’t necessarily mean outdated. What came before may contain the ingredient you’re missing now.
fortunes.health: Return to a healthy habit that used to work for you.
fortunes.wealth: Something you’ve already learned may help you make a smarter financial decision.
fortunes.love: An old lesson is repeating itself. You don’t necessarily need the old person, but you may need to remember what they taught you.
fortunes.workStudy: Revisit an abandoned idea, skill, connection, or project. It may make more sense now.
fortunes.luckyDishNote: The old recipe, still exactly right.

fortunes.title: The Chili Storm
fortunes.overall: Things may get a little spicy. Don’t panic. Change sometimes arrives loudly. Like Pla Lad Preeg, contrast and heat can transform something familiar into something completely different.
fortunes.health: Stress may be running high. Give yourself somewhere productive to put that energy.
fortunes.wealth: Avoid impulse spending or decisions made because you’re feeling pressured.
fortunes.love: A disagreement may reveal something important. Listen to what’s underneath the argument.
fortunes.workStudy: A disruption could force a better solution. Adapt before you resist.
fortunes.luckyDishNote: Heat and contrast, familiar made new.

fortunes.title: The Perfect Bite
fortunes.overall: You are trying to choose between things that may not actually require a choice. Mieng Pla Pao works because many different flavors belong in the same bite. Your life might, too.
fortunes.health: Balance movement with rest and discipline with enjoyment.
fortunes.wealth: Enjoy your money, but leave something for future you.
fortunes.love: Independence and closeness can coexist. You don’t have to lose yourself to love someone.
fortunes.workStudy: Two seemingly different interests or skills may work better together than separately.

fortunes.title: Let It Cook
fortunes.overall: Unfortunately, fate has prescribed patience. Like Short Ribs Panang, some things get better precisely because they aren’t rushed.
fortunes.health: Progress may feel slow, but slow progress is still progress.
fortunes.wealth: Think long term. This is a better season for building than gambling.
fortunes.love: Stop pulling the plant out of the soil to see whether the roots are growing. Give the situation some room.
fortunes.workStudy: Something you’re working toward needs more time. Don’t mistake “not yet” for “no.”

fortunes.title: Follow the Current
fortunes.overall: You’ve been trying to control every variable. Fate would like you to knock that off for a minute. Like Chilean Sea Bass moving with the current, sometimes the better direction appears when you stop fighting the flow.
fortunes.health: Release some tension. Your body may be asking for less stimulation and more recovery.
fortunes.wealth: Stay flexible. An unexpected expense or opportunity may require you to adjust your plans.
fortunes.love: Stop trying to predict the ending while you’re still in the middle.
fortunes.workStudy: Your original plan may change. The alternative route could actually be better.
fortunes.luckyDishNote: It moves with the current, not against it.

fortunes.title: The Sweet Life
fortunes.overall: Not everything needs to become productive, impressive, or meaningful. Some things are allowed to simply be good. Mango Sticky Rice has entered the chat.
fortunes.health: Rest and pleasure are part of taking care of yourself too.
fortunes.wealth: You’re allowed a small treat. Just don’t turn “the universe told me to” into a shopping strategy.
fortunes.love: Enjoy what’s happening instead of immediately asking where it’s going.
fortunes.workStudy: Celebrate something you’ve already accomplished before moving the goalpost again.

fortunes.title: The Second Serving
fortunes.overall: Something deserves another chance, but not necessarily in the same form. Fate isn’t asking you to repeat the past. It’s asking whether you’ve learned enough to try differently.
fortunes.health: If one approach hasn’t worked, change the method rather than abandoning the goal.
fortunes.wealth: Revisit an opportunity you previously dismissed, but look at the numbers with fresh eyes.
fortunes.love: Second chances can work when behavior changes. Nostalgia alone isn’t evidence.
fortunes.workStudy: An old idea may succeed with a new collaborator, context, or execution.
fortunes.luckySign: Something familiar appearing in an unexpected place.

fortunes.title: The Empty Plate
fortunes.overall: Make room. This is less a fortune about what is coming and more about what needs to leave before something new can arrive.
fortunes.health: Your body and brain may need actual downtime. Empty space isn’t wasted space.
fortunes.wealth: Clear unnecessary expenses, subscriptions, clutter, or obligations before adding something new.
fortunes.love: Don’t keep a seat occupied for someone who isn’t sitting at the table.
fortunes.workStudy: Finish, delegate, archive, or abandon something. Your next idea needs somewhere to land.
fortunes.luckySign: An unexpected ending that feels more relieving than sad.
